confidence_notes: Food and drink estimates use current crowdsourced Inverness prices, but local samples are sparse and mid-range meal estimates vary between snapshots. Wine is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation is a holistic July high-season estimate, not based on live booking prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: No city proxy used for food and drink; accommodation reflects Inverness as a small Scottish Highlands tourism hub during peak July season.
